claims.statement: MRM-POL-02 v7.0 is approved by the Board Risk Committee (2026-06-18), owned by Jonathan Price (Head of Model Risk Management), effective 2026-07-01, classified INTERNAL - CONFIDENTIAL, and re-baselines against the April 17, 2026 interagency guidance (Federal Reserve SR 26-2; OCC Bulletin 2026-13; FDIC FIL-15-2026) that rescinded SR 11-7 / OCC 2011-12.

MRM-POL-02 defines a Model as a quantitative method of meaningful complexity producing estimates/predictions used in decisions or communicated to clients, an End-User Analytic (EUA) as simple descriptive calculations with no forward-looking estimation requiring Archer registration and business-owner attestation but no independent validation, and a customer-facing estimate as any forward-looking value shown to a client.

MRM-POL-02 Section 3 defines four tiers with exact criteria and validation requirements: Tier 1 (regulatory/capital/financial-crimes/high exposure, full independent validation + annual review), Tier 2 (customer-facing estimates or models influencing client decisions/treatment, independent validation 10-14 weeks / 160-240 validator hours), Tier 3 (internal operational, limited exposure, targeted validation 6-9 weeks), and EUA (descriptive only, registration + attestation ~2 weeks); customer-facing estimates are Tier 2 at minimum and may not be shown to clients before validation and approved use conditions are complete.

MRM-POL-02 Section 4 forbids use of financial-crimes (Tier 1) model outputs - including Sentinel fraud scores (M-FCT-0021) and beneficiary mule-risk features (M-FCT-0034) - for product, marketing, or client-facing purposes, restricts model use to registered purposes, and requires compensating controls and outcome monitoring for vendor models where developers cannot provide sufficient information.

The MRM-POL-02 Treasury & Payments model inventory extract lists exactly: M-FCT-0021 (Sentinel payment fraud score, vendor, Tier 1, owner Victor Petrov, Validated 2025-12); M-FCT-0034 (Beneficiary mule-risk features, Tier 1, owner Victor Petrov, Validated 2026-02); M-TRS-0142 (Treasury Insights cash forecast, Tier 3 re-tiering to 2 under v7.0 review, owner Wei Zhang, Validated 2025-09, 9 weeks); and EUA-TRS-0007 (Ops corridor completion dashboard, EUA, owner Denise Carter, Registered 2026-05).

As of the Q4-2026 capacity notice, the Tier 2 validation queue is approximately 6 weeks before work starts, submissions must include development documentation, data lineage, and proposed monitoring, and the named Validation Lead for Treasury & Operations models is Sophie Laurent.
